dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Elchingen! Fancy meeting you here!

dialogues.speaker: Elchingen
dialogues.text: Congratulations on advancing to the finals. Your duel with Haniyyah and the Ultimate Trial will no doubt be the highlight of this tournament.

dialogues.speaker: Elchingen
dialogues.text: Practicing aside, taking a walk is a good way to prepare yourself for the final. It keeps your mind clear and your spirits up.

response.speaker: Elchingen
response.text: I just wanted to find a quiet spot to reflect on what I have learned... what you have shown me.

response.speaker: Elchingen
response.text: I am now, more than ever, convinced that the relationship between master and servant improves dramatically when the servant is well-behaved...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Master? Servant? What does that have to do with us?

choices.text: I'll leave you in peace, then.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Oh, uh... Yeah! We have something super important to tell you next time we meet!

response.speaker: Elchingen
response.text: Very well. I shall patiently look forward to it. Best of luck with your preparations.

choices.text: All on your own here, I see...
